subject.title: WhatsApp pairing can stick at Logging in until gateway restart finalizes 515 recovery

question: Should the reported 515/manual-restart recovery gap stay as a separate WhatsApp recovery tracker, or be folded into the phone-code login acceptance criteria?
rationale: Current main lacks the phone-code path that triggered the field sequence, and the open implementation PRs require a public channel-auth/API decision before this issue can be resolved safely.

options.title: Keep Separate Recovery Tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open until a live WhatsApp phone-code or QR relink proves that 515 finalization no longer requires an operator gateway restart.

options.title: Fold Into Phone-Code PR
options.body: Treat restart-free 515 finalization and partial-credential cleanup as required proof before landing the phone-code login PR.

options.title: Defer Until After Phone-Code Lands
options.body: Close or retarget this only after the phone-code entrypoint ships and a fresh report shows whether the 515 recovery gap still exists.

recommendation.title: Keep Separate Recovery Tracker
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until a live WhatsApp phone-code or QR relink proves that 515 finalization no longer requires an operator gateway restart.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice crosses public CLI, plugin SDK, and WhatsApp auth/session boundaries where prior channel-auth history points to this owner as the best routing candidate.
